name: Wi-Fi
simple: The request flies through the air as radio waves – no wire needed!
technical: 802.11ax on 5 GHz: OFDMA sub-carriers, 1024-QAM, WPA3 encryption between the device and the AP.

2010.technical: 802.11n on 2.4 or 5 GHz: OFDM sub-carriers, 64-QAM, MIMO streams, WPA2 encryption between the device and the AP.
